description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs:747: ValidatedPath doc says 'Copy stability is committed for all v0.1.x releases. Any future field additions that are non-Copy will be added in a new minor version (v0.2+) with an explicit removal of the Copy derive, constituting a breaking change.' This promise is well-intentioned but unnecessary. #[non_exhaustive] already prevents exhaustive matching and struct literal construction. If a useful non-Copy field (e.g., a policy OID set from the validated policy tree) needs to be added in a minor release, this promise blocks it. The promise should be weakened to 'Copy may be removed in minor versions with a deprecation notice in the changelog.'
notes: ValidatedPath.copy_promise is documented at lib.rs:743 as a committed API guarantee. This is a design record, not a bug.
title: ValidatedPath Copy stability promise may block adding non-Copy fields in v0.1.x
